message.starfold_mining.survey.waypoint_: Survey saved. Your waypoint book is full (%s). Remove a waypoint and rescan to add a navigation marker.
message.starfold_mining.survey.history_f: Survey history is full (%s). The oldest survey was replaced. Its waypoint is still in your book.
message.starfold_mining.survey.data_erro: Could not read or save your mining surveys. Your existing discoveries were kept.
tooltip.starfold_mining.mining_platform: Place, add fuel, scan the ground, then start mining.
Open the platform and hover over ? for operating instructions.
screen.starfold_mining.stop_mode_hint: Stop at a block the platform cannot mine. Click to skip instead.
screen.starfold_mining.skip_mode_hint: Leave unmineable blocks in place and move to the next position. Protection and work-area limits still stop the platform. Click to stop at obstructions.
screen.starfold_mining.scan_hint: Survey the ground beneath this platform.
screen.starfold_mining.start_hint: Start or resume the current mining plan.
screen.starfold_mining.pause_hint: Pause excavation. Stored items stay in the output slots.
screen.starfold_mining.reset_hint: Pause first, then reset the survey and mining plan. Stored outputs are kept.
screen.starfold_mining.fuel_hint: Insert an accepted solid fuel to power the platform.
screen.starfold_mining.guide:
1. Place the platform on stationary planetary ground.
2. Add solid fuel and press Scan. Pause can stop a survey or excavation.
3. The first three known ore types show counts and depth below the platform; hover a row for its full text.
4. After the survey finishes, press Start to excavate. Collect items from the two output rows.
5. Hover the status for survey progress and excavated positions. If work stops, check fuel, output space and the status.
6. Pause before Reset to clear the work plan; stored outputs are kept.
screen.starfold_mining.obstruction.scan_: Platform too low for survey depth
screen.starfold_mining.obstruction.wrong: Target outside the platform's planetary work area
screen.starfold_mining.obstruction.fluid: Fluid or waterlogged block in shaft
screen.starfold_mining.obstruction.tool_: Built-in iron pickaxe tier too low
screen.starfold_mining.obstruction_posit: Position: X %s, Y %s, Z %s (%s blocks below)
screen.starfold_mining.obstruction_retry: No reason was recorded for the last stop. Retry to see the details.
oil.starfold_mining.survey_hint: Survey only this canonical chunk: 100 ticks, 10 FE/tick. Resume keeps paid progress.
oil.starfold_mining.build_hint: Build a virtual well to core shell/bedrock, at 80 FE per layer. Terrain stays intact; protection still applies.
oil.starfold_mining.pump_hint: Pump through a valid well: up to 100 mB each second, 2 FE/mB. Only the owner can operate controls.
oil.starfold_mining.pause_hint: Pause work and fuel use. Stored energy, oil and progress remain.
oil.starfold_mining.guide: Place on your home planet, outside ships. Owner must be online; chunks must already be loaded. Survey → Well → Pump. Virtual rods are included in the recipe; no terrain is removed and no ore drops. Empty bucket: collect oil. Pipes can drain all sides; FE input on all sides. Drain the tank before breaking: contents are lost.
oil.starfold_mining.energy_hint: Receive-only FE. Remaining fuel work: %s ticks; 10 FE/tick when needed.
oil.starfold_mining.tank_hint: Crude oil output only. Empty bucket or a pipe can drain. Full tank stops fuel, energy and reservoir consumption.
oil.starfold_mining.remaining_hint: Last local reading, in mB. CDG pumpjacks share this reservoir. Every extraction reads the live amount again.
oil.starfold_mining.status.idle_hint: Owner: press Survey. No work or fuel is spent while idle.
oil.starfold_mining.status.surveying_hin: Only the loaded canonical chunk below this machine is sampled; costs 1000 FE total.
oil.starfold_mining.status.found_hint: Press Well to validate a vertical route down to bedrock/core shell.
oil.starfold_mining.status.dry_hint: No oil is available in the shared CDG reservoir. Try another chunk.
oil.starfold_mining.status.building_hint: 80 FE per layer, one layer per 10 active ticks. No terrain changes.
oil.starfold_mining.status.well_ready_hi: Press Pump. The whole virtual route is checked again for each batch.
oil.starfold_mining.status.pumping_hint: Up to 100 mB per second, 2 FE per mB actually accepted.
oil.starfold_mining.status.paused_hint: Select Survey, Well or Pump to resume available work.
oil.starfold_mining.status.no_energy_hin: Insert furnace fuel or connect an FE source. Partial progress is retained.
oil.starfold_mining.status.full_hint: Drain with an empty bucket or pipe. No fuel, energy or oil is consumed while full.
oil.starfold_mining.status.unloaded_hint: This machine never requests chunk loading; keep the working chunk loaded normally.
oil.starfold_mining.status.blocked_hint: Stopped by fluid, block entity, non-terrain, unbreakable block, invalid bottom or excessive depth. Clear safely, then resume.
oil.starfold_mining.status.protected_hin: Owner permissions and break-protection hooks apply to every virtual layer, including the terminal sensor. No blocks are broken.
oil.starfold_mining.status.owner_away_hi: The placing player must be online. No fuel or work is consumed while offline.
oil.starfold_mining.status.unsupported_h: Place on canonical owned home terrain. Ship storage, seam aliases and relocated machines are unsupported.
oil.starfold_mining.status.cdg_missing_h: Install the pinned Create Diesel Generators integration to use oil. Solid mining works independently.
oil.starfold_mining.status.cdg_error_hin: Oil was not granted. Check the server log and pinned CDG 1.3.15 API; restart after fixing integration.
oil.starfold_mining.status.fuel_output_f: Empty the Returns slot so fuel container remainders can be stored safely.
